notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased medium game speed from 2 → 3 and max game speed from 4 → 6.
[*] Improved tooltip text readability on cards.
[*] Added new cards for the Soul Lantern tower.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where cards sometimes didn’t save correctly in the deck.
[*] Fixed boss animations during days 20 and 30.
[*] Panels that were not closing in certain situations now behave as intended.
[*] Corruption spread speed now scales with game speed.
[*] Improved how certain UI panels adapt to different resolutions.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where some towers did not properly update their neighbors.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi we are happy to announce that another update is live! In this one some small fixes but also another deck with a new tower to play. We hope you will have fun with it.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new deck with another tower and more cards 
[*]Increased camera speed when zoomed in
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tutorial should not start after each update for players that finished it
[*]Fixed scrolling speed on some UI panels
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added more cards to the Shard Tower deck - this deck is supposed to have more than one available build, but with the previous amount of cards near the end of the run players were often forced to pick upgrades that don't fit their playstyle, additional cards should help with that
[*]Changed visuals of some enemies  
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Towers no longer can target enemies outside of their range at the beginning of the round
[*]There is no longer access to the debug mode from tutorial
[*]Reshuffle tooltip now  disappears properly
[*]Tower panel now will update properly after tower levels up while it is open
[*]Ambient volume should no longer reset to 0 after each round
[*]Fixed some translation inconsistencies
[*]Changed the detection method for projectiles to more accurate one
[*]Fixed the detection of neighbouring towers and towers detected in range of the tower - it impacted some of the upgrades 
[/list]
